run_get_indicators: run the get_indicators tool to retrieve a technical indicator for a given ticker symbol and date
test_get_indicators: test the get_indicators tool with a ticker symbol, indicator name, current date, and look back days
refactor_get_indicators: refactor the get_indicators tool to handle multiple comma-separated technical indicators
review_get_indicators: review the get_indicators tool that routes requests to the technical_indicators vendor
summarize_get_indicators: summarize the get_indicators tool that returns formatted dataframe results for a ticker symbol and indicator
